engineering_objective: Complete a self-hosted AWS NLB-style service whose Go control plane safely distributes immutable listener and target-group snapshots to a fleet of C++ userspace TCP dataplanes.

distinctive_center: zonal target eligibility and fail-open policy
restart-safe desired, acknowledged, and active generations

cpp_data_plane: epoll TCP accept and proxy workers
integration: generation prepare, activate, reject, and acknowledge states

operational_requirements: Canonicalize and validate listeners, target groups, targets, health policies, balancing policies, and zonal policy before allocating a generation.
Fence desired-state writes by revision and idempotency key; stale, duplicate, and conflicting requests must not alter accepted authority.
Compile one immutable complete snapshot and digest for each accepted revision.
Roll snapshots through prepare and activate phases so a node never serves partially updated listener and target-group state.
Require node session identity and monotonic acknowledgement; stale processes cannot acknowledge or activate work for a replacement session.
Preserve the last active generation when a candidate is rejected or a rollout cannot meet its configured quorum.
Proxy real TCP byte streams with half-close, backpressure, bounded buffers, connect timeout, idle timeout, and deterministic error handling.
Support round-robin, least-connections, and source-address-hash selection over eligible targets.
Combine administrative state, active health, passive failure ejection, zone policy, and draining state when determining eligibility.
Stop assigning new connections after target deregistration while allowing owned connections to drain to a deadline.
Implement cross-zone enabled and same-zone-preferred behavior with explicit fail-open policy when healthy capacity is unavailable.
Support PROXY protocol v2 emission as the source-identity preservation contract without spoofing socket peer addresses.
Keep each connection on the generation and target incarnation it acquired; later rollouts cannot redirect an established stream.
Persist complete desired snapshots, rollout state, active dataplane checkpoints, source fences, and bounded continuity state atomically.
Recover safely from corrupt CURRENT pointers, incomplete generations, torn control messages, control-plane restart, and dataplane restart.
Make repeated apply, reconnect, prepare, activate, drain, and recovery operations idempotent.
Expose stable status, readiness, metrics, connection, rollout, and audit views without unbounded labels or payload leakage.
Bound control queues, retained generations, health history, audit events, connection metadata, and retired runtime objects.
Remain deterministic and self-contained over loopback networking; never modify host routes, firewall rules, or cloud resources.

root_cause_clusters.RC_CONTROL_AUTHORITY: Revision, idempotency, node-session, and acknowledgement authority are not consistently fenced.
root_cause_clusters.RC_SNAPSHOT_ATOMICITY: Validation, compilation, prepare, activation, and persistence do not form one immutable generation lifecycle.
root_cause_clusters.RC_CONNECTION_OWNERSHIP: Accepted connections do not retain stable generation, target incarnation, and shutdown ownership.
root_cause_clusters.RC_TARGET_ELIGIBILITY: Health, zone, administrative, ejection, and draining states are combined inconsistently.
root_cause_clusters.RC_STREAM_CORRECTNESS: The TCP dataplane mishandles partial I/O, half-close, buffering, timeouts, and PROXY protocol framing.
root_cause_clusters.RC_RECOVERY_RETENTION: Restart, fallback, reconnect, and retention can lose authority or retire still-reachable state.
root_cause_clusters.RC_OPERABILITY: Status, metrics, readiness, audit, and bounded-resource contracts diverge across components.

defects.observable_failure: Global revision fencing and per-node acknowledgement sequence share one counter, so a node acknowledgement can advance the accepted desired revision or block a legitimate apply.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Splitting counters without also fencing idempotency keys and node-session identity still leaves D02, D03, and D04 reachable.

defects.observable_failure: The same revision number with a different compiled digest is accepted as a no-op or replacement instead of being rejected as a conflict.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Comparing only the revision integer still permits silent authority drift when body content changes under the same revision.

defects.observable_failure: Repeating an idempotency key with a different request body returns success or mutates desired state instead of rejecting the conflict.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Storing the first payload but not comparing subsequent bodies still accepts D02-style digest drift under a new key.

defects.observable_failure: A superseded dataplane session can activate a prepared generation after the control plane has registered a replacement session for the same node.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Checking session identity only at registration time still permits stale processes to acknowledge or activate after reconnect churn.

defects.observable_failure: Rollout quorum treats disconnected or superseded node sessions as acknowledged participants, declaring success while healthy nodes never activated the candidate.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Excluding explicitly disconnected sessions but still counting superseded session tokens leaves false quorum under process restart.

defects.observable_failure: A runtime generation is allocated and persisted before semantic validation and compilation finish, leaving partial or invalid snapshots referenced by rollout state.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Moving validation earlier without serializing prepare and activation still allows D07 mixed-revision publication.

defects.observable_failure: Listener tables and target-group tables from different accepted revisions become simultaneously active because publication swaps them through separate visibility points.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Locking listener replacement alone does not restore atomicity if target groups, health views, or generation metadata publish separately.

defects.observable_failure: Rejecting a candidate revision mutates or clears the last-known-good active generation instead of preserving the prior acknowledged snapshot.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Preserving the dataplane serving pointer while still poisoning repository CURRENT metadata recreates D09 on restart.

defects.observable_failure: The durable CURRENT pointer references a generation whose body failed verification, was never fully compiled, or lacks a matching digest.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Verifying file presence without digest, schema, and completeness checks still lets restart publish torn generations.

defects.observable_failure: An established connection re-resolves backend selection against the newly published snapshot instead of retaining the generation and target it acquired at accept time.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Caching only the target pointer without binding generation and incarnation still permits mid-stream reassignment after rollout.

defects.observable_failure: A target removed and later re-added reuses the previous target incarnation, inheriting drain state, health evidence, and balancer counters.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Allocating a new runtime object but copying counters and drain flags from the retired incarnation preserves D16 leakage.

defects.observable_failure: Drain deadline retires proxy buffers or backend handles while a connection registry entry still owns unread or in-flight bytes.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Waiting for the in-flight counter alone ignores half-closed directions and reusable buffer pools still referenced by the registry.

defects.observable_failure: Passive failure ejection permanently marks a target ineligible even when active-health recovery policy would restore it after the configured probe successes.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Clearing passive state only on administrative re-register still leaves targets ejected after transient backend resets.

defects.observable_failure: Cross-zone load balancing remains enabled for selection even when the listener or target-group policy disables remote zone targets.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Filtering remote targets only in round-robin but not in least-connections or source-hash still violates zonal policy.

defects.observable_failure: Fail-open selection includes administratively disabled or draining targets when no healthy same-zone capacity exists.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Excluding only explicitly unhealthy targets still admits administratively disabled members during fail-open.

defects.observable_failure: Least-connections counters from a removed target incarnation continue to influence selection after the target is re-added.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Resetting counters only at administrative delete without incarnation identity still leaks state across remove and re-add cycles.

defects.observable_failure: Source-address-hash selection changes when equivalent target declarations are reordered even though semantic membership is unchanged.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Sorting targets for display without defining a canonical selection order still makes affinity depend on declaration order.

defects.observable_failure: Partial write handling drops or truncates client-to-target traffic instead of resuming until the full buffered slice is delivered.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Retrying only the first partial write on the next event loop turn still loses bytes when epoll edge semantics coalesce errors.

defects.observable_failure: Observing FIN or shutdown on one direction immediately closes or resets the opposite direction before the peer finishes draining.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Delaying the opposite shutdown without honoring half-close read interest still truncates slow readers.

defects.observable_failure: Backpressure on a slow reader allows upstream buffers to grow without bound instead of pausing reads at the configured limit.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Capping per-connection buffer count but not unregistering read interest lets memory grow through many idle connections.

defects.observable_failure: Idle timeout fires while buffered bytes remain queued in either direction, terminating streams that still have deliverable data.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Resetting the idle timer on any I/O without checking pending buffer depth still closes connections with unread payload.

defects.observable_failure: After backend reconnect, the dataplane emits a second PROXY protocol v2 header on the same TCP stream.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Suppressing PROXY on reconnect only for the same backend socket still duplicates headers when worker pools rotate handles.

defects.observable_failure: A torn or truncated length-prefixed control frame still advances node acknowledgement or activate state on the control plane.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Checksum-only framing without transactional commit ordering still permits D25 activate-before-prepare replay.

defects.observable_failure: Control-plane restart forgets the last accepted revision fence and permits stale apply requests that were valid before the outage.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Restoring CURRENT generation without recovered revision and idempotency fences still accepts superseded writes after restart.

defects.observable_failure: Dataplane reconnect replays an activate message before the corresponding prepare was durably accepted for the current session.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Persisting the last activate pointer without generation phase ordering still publishes D07 mixed snapshots after reconnect.

defects.observable_failure: Generation retention evicts a snapshot generation still referenced by active connection registry entries or in-flight proxy state.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Reference counting only live connections but not checkpoint reachability still deletes generations needed for D10 ownership.

defects.observable_failure: Readiness reports true while listener sockets still serve a generation older than the fleet-acknowledged active revision.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Checking control-plane acknowledgement alone ignores dataplane publication lag and leaves D29 shutdown race reachable.

defects.observable_failure: Metrics and status exports retain unbounded generation, target, and incarnation labels across retired rollouts.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Deleting metric values on target removal without generation-scoped retirement still accumulates stale series for old incarnations.

defects.observable_failure: After readiness drops, the dataplane accept loop continues to admit new connections until process exit.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Stopping the status server but leaving the epoll accept path registered still violates graceful shutdown semantics.

data_and_runtime_plan.fleet: Deterministic inventory of 24 dataplane nodes across three zones with varied sessions, revisions, health, and rollout states.
data_and_runtime_plan.configuration: Deterministic generated catalog of listeners, target groups, targets, policies, and rollout histories large enough for strict production-state reasoning without generated LOC counting.
data_and_runtime_plan.network_lab: Loopback TCP echo, slow-reader, half-close, reset, and PROXY-protocol inspection backends.
